Melissa Schoenberg (also credited as Melissa Hope) is a voice actress for the English dub for .

==Biography==
Schoenberg has been acting since 2007, providing her voice for the English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. From 2009 to 2010, she voiced the Pokémon Coordinator Ursula during of the . Then, starting in 2017, Schoenberg voiced James's Mareanie and in , under the working alias "Melissa Hope".
